# Collective Loft

> Collective Loft (collectiveloft.com) is a professional network for the creative class: artists, musicians, writers, designers, filmmakers, photographers, performers, and creative technologists. Members find collaborators, agree on real terms (compensation, rights, timeline) before work begins, and work together in a shared workspace called a Loft Studio. Every finished collaboration leaves a record: terms honored, work completed, ratings earned.

Collective Loft is not a gig marketplace and not a job board. It is structured agreement infrastructure for creative collaboration. Membership is $15 a month after a 7-day trial. It is a Morgan Collective Group company, based in Chicago and London. Launched August 1, 2026 with a founding class of 50 creatives.
